submission.justification: Absorber-F1 gave the best resolution of the three materials in every comparison. F1 was 3.82%, F2 4.35% and F3 5.90% at 2 mm. The 2025 summary at 5 mm gives F1 3.2%, F2 3.9% and F3 5.1%. I scanned F1 from 2 to 10 mm, and the lowest value was 3.155% at 6 mm. Resolution is 3.26% at 7 mm and 3.36% at 4 mm and 5.5 mm. It degrades at 8 mm (3.68%) and 10 mm (4.49%). The scan is noisy, so the optimum is probably broad, around 5–7 mm. I did not scan F2 or F3 across thicknesses. Their 2 mm and 5 mm results are well behind F1, so I doubt a different thickness would change the ranking. CAVEAT: none of the documents give activation or radiation-hardness data for any material. I could not confirm that F1 allows hands-on maintenance, so that constraint needs checking with radiation-protection experts before the choice is final.
